name: secskills-core
description: The reverse-engineering and code-audit foundation both sides share. 30 dual-use security skills: native and Go/Rust/.NET/iOS/firmware reverse engineering, packers, and Flutter/React Native/Unity/Xamarin runtimes; source-code auditing with PHP-specific depth; webshell and backdoor hunting; multi-agent vulnerability-research orchestration; supply-chain, cryptography, MCP, and pull-request review; vetting third-party agent skills and MCP servers; AI/LLM security; ATT&CK technique mapping; engagement-state discipline; and findings reporting. Ships the ttp-index.json ATT&CK map. Every skill fact-checked against primary sources. Use when reversing a binary, auditing code, hunting a backdoor, running a vulnerability-discovery campaign, reviewing crypto, or mapping techniques.
